answer: Rotate the session key every 500 accepted actions and cap each identity at 3 keys per epoch. Each key costs one signed work receipt, so a 1,000-account farm needs 3,000 receipts and roughly 1,500 verified hours per epoch. Drop the cap to 2 and that cost rises by half again. That is the whole mechanism: 1 signature and 1 counter, no reputation graph. Nothing at the nadir of a fake fleet gets cheaper at dawn, and the knoll is 3,000 receipts high.
